correctness.rationale: Exact Lanczos residual AV=VT+beta v_{k+1}e_k^T, independent Gaussian sketches, and Schur elimination give T+t e_k^T, terminal coefficient c/(1+a^Tt), and scaled Student-t with nu=s-k+1. Irreducible SPD tridiagonal cofactor gives c != 0. The Student density at -1 is strictly positive, giving sharp 1/R tail and all p>=1 divergent error moments; beta=0 gives exact invariance. The packaged standard-library checker passed 1767 exact-rational reduced matrix identities and 12 local density integrations; these corroborate but do not replace the universal proof.

value.rationale: Unconditional expected sketched FOM inverse errors are infinite even with very large but finite Gaussian oversampling and for explicit condition-number-below-three positive-definite systems. The complete invariant/noninvariant classification and exact polynomial tail coefficient explain a concrete rare-event stability barrier not addressed by conditional embedding guarantees. This motivates explicit conditioning or safeguarding in stochastic-error interpretations without claiming such a safeguard was proved here.
